articles.title: 15 penny stocks surge up to 80% in 3 months. Do you own any?
articles.content: Fifteen penny stocks have delivered returns of 20% to 80% over the past three months. Screened on the basis of a market capitalisation below Rs 1,000 crore, a share price under Rs 20 and average trading volumes exceeding 5 lakh shares, these micro-cap stocks have emerged as standout performers. However, investors should note that while penny stocks can offer outsized gains, they also carry higher risks due to sharp price volatility and liquidity concerns.

articles.title: SpaceX and other mega IPOs may wait years to join the S&P 500

articles.title: Macquarie initiates 'Underperform' rating on Meesho, sees 25% downside. Here's why
articles.content: Macquarie has initiated coverage on Meesho with an ‘Underperform’ rating and a target price of Rs 125, implying nearly 25% downside. articles.title: James Montier’s Formula for Investment Success: Master Your Mind Before the Market
articles.content: Behavioural finance expert James Montier argues that investment success depends more on controlling emotions than predicting markets. By avoiding common biases, focusing on facts, maintaining discipline, and thinking long term, investors can improve decision-making and enhance returns. Mastering psychology, he says, is often more valuable than mastering finance.

articles.title: When is the best time to trade crypto in India?
articles.content: Crypto markets operate 24/7, offering Indian traders opportunities beyond traditional market hours. articles.title: Zinc prices at multi-year highs: What’s driving the rally and what lies ahead?
